###==== GSE136103 ==== # 

```{r}
base_dir <- "../data/GSE136103_Data/use" 

sample_dirs <- list.dirs(
  base_dir,
  recursive = FALSE,
  full.names = TRUE
)

seurat_list_1 <- lapply(seq_along(sample_dirs), function(i){

  sample_path <- sample_dirs[i]

  sample_name <- basename(sample_path)

  counts <- Read10X(sample_path)

  obj <- CreateSeuratObject(
    counts = counts,
    project = "GSE136103",
    min.cells = 3,
    min.features = 200
  )

  obj$sample <- sample_name
  obj$sample_id <- i + 0 
  obj$dataset <- "GSE136103"
  obj$condition <- "cirrhosis"

  obj[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(
    obj,
    pattern = "^MT-"
  )

  obj

})

names(seurat_list_1) <- paste0(
  "sample_",
  1:9
)
```


```{r}
qc_before <- get_qc_summary(seurat_list_1)
qc_before
```

```{r}
plot_vln_qc(seurat_list_1)
plot_scatter_qc(seurat_list_1)
```

```{r}

qc_threshold_1 <- data.frame(
  max_feature = c(3500, 4500, 4500, 4000, 4500, 4500, 4000, 3500, 4000),
  max_count   = c(20000, 20000, 20000, 20000, 20000, 20000, 20000, 20000, 20000),
  max_mt      = c(25, 25, 25, 25, 25, 25, 25, 25, 25), 
  min_feature = c(300, 300, 300, 300, 300, 300, 300, 300, 300)
)

seurat_list_1 <- filter_qc(seurat_list_1, qc_threshold_1)

```

```{r}
plot_scatter_qc(seurat_list_1)
plot_vln_qc(seurat_list_1)
```

```{r}
qc_after <- get_qc_summary(seurat_list_1)
qc_after
```

```{r}
saveRDS(seurat_list_1, file = "results/RDS/seurat_list_1.rds")
```

###==== GSE186343 ==== # 
```{r}
install.packages("hdf5r")

library(hdf5r)
base_dir <- "../data/GSE186343_Data/use"

sample_files <- list.files(
  base_dir,
  pattern = "\\.h5$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

seurat_list_2 <- lapply(seq_along(sample_files), function(i){

  file <- sample_files[i]

  sample_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(file))

  counts <- Read10X_h5(file)

  obj <- CreateSeuratObject(
    counts = counts,
    project = "GSE186343",
    min.cells = 3,
    min.features = 200
  )

  obj$sample <- sample_name
  obj$sample_id <- i + 9
  obj$dataset <- "GSE186343"
  obj$condition <- "HBV"

  obj[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(
    obj,
    pattern = "^MT-"
  )

  obj

})

names(seurat_list_2) <- paste0(
  "sample_",
  10:14
)
```

```{r}
qc_before <- get_qc_summary(seurat_list_2)
qc_before
```

```{r}
# tự chỉnh qc_threshold
qc_threshold_2 <- data.frame(
  max_feature = c(4500, 4500, 4500, 4500, 4500),
  max_count   = c(20000, 20000, 20000, 20000, 20000),
  max_mt      = c(25, 25, 25, 25, 25),
  min_feature = c(300, 300, 300, 300, 300)
)

seurat_list_2 <- filter_qc(seurat_list_2, qc_threshold_2)
```

```{r}
plot_vln_qc(seurat_list_2)
plot_scatter_qc(seurat_list_2)
```

```{r}
qc_after <- get_qc_summary(seurat_list_2)
qc_after
```

```{r}
saveRDS(seurat_list_2, file = "../results/RDS/seurat_list_2.rds")
```

###==== GSE242889 ==== #

```{r}
  base_dir,
  pattern = "^genes\\.tsv\\.gz$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)

gene_files
for (f in gene_files) {
```

###==== GSE202642 ==== # 
```{r}
sample_path <- "../data/GSE202642_Data/use"   

counts <- Read10X(sample_path)

obj <- CreateSeuratObject(
  counts = counts,
  #project = "GSE202642",
  min.cells = 3,
  min.features = 200
)

obj$sample <- "GSE202642"
obj$sample_id <- 20
obj$dataset <- "GSE202642"
obj$condition <- "HCC"

obj[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(
  obj,
  pattern = "^MT-"
)
```

```{r}
obj$cell_barcode <- rownames(obj@meta.data)

obj$sample_suffix <- sapply(strsplit(obj$cell_barcode, "-"), `[`, 2)

head(obj@meta.data[, c("cell_barcode", "sample_suffix")], 10)
```

```{r}
table(obj$sample_suffix)
```

```{r}
# Select 7 samples (T)
obj <- subset(
  obj,
  subset = sample_suffix %in% as.character(1:7)
)
```

```{r}
# Split obj
seurat_list_4 <- SplitObject(
  obj,
  split.by = "sample_suffix"
)

names(seurat_list_4) <- paste0("sample_", 20:26)
```

```{r}
for(i in seq_along(seurat_list_4)){

  seurat_list_4[[i]]$sample_id <- as.numeric(
    sub(
      "sample_",
      "",
      names(seurat_list_4)[i]
    )
  )
}
```

```{r}
qc_before
```
